name: 59715 · Bozeman, MT
findings: ZIP 59715 (Bozeman) has 274 nonprofit organizations. 122 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 94 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 59715 (Bozeman) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 59715 (Bozeman) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
